description: This file defines a generic data service class 'CatalogLookupDataService' that fetches lookup data from an API endpoint. It uses dependency injection for HttpClient, logging, and configuration, and employs generics with constraints to specify data types and response types. The class is part of the 'BlazorAdmin.Services' namespace.

classes.name: CatalogLookupDataService<TLookupData, TReponse>
classes.description: A generic service class for performing lookup data retrieval from a REST API, configurable via options and supporting dependency injection.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches a list of lookup data items from the API, using reflection to determine the endpoint name based on the 'EndpointAttribute' attached to the 'TLookupData' type.
